questions.short_title: Unseaworthy Vessels under the Merchant Shipping Act, 1958
questions.text_verbatim: a) What do you understand by Unseaworthy vessel within the meaning of the Merchant Shipping Act (MSA), 1958, as amended? (5) b) What according to you is the difference between Unseaworthy ship and Unsafe ship. (6) c) What are the obligations of owners to crew with respect seaworthiness. (5)

subparts.text: What is meant by an unseaworthy vessel within the meaning of the Merchant Shipping Act (MSA), 1958, as amended.
The difference between an unseaworthy ship and an unsafe ship.
The obligations of owners to crew with respect to seaworthiness.

reuse_evidence: No family member with a built answer. Treat as new research until a solving session establishes otherwise.

notes: This sitting predates 15 March 2026, when the Merchant Shipping Act, 2025 commenced and repealed the Merchant Shipping Act, 1958 by s.324(1). The answer is governed by the 1958 Act as it stood at the sitting; the stem names that Act expressly. Reusing a 2026 object that was re-anchored onto the 2025 Act is a statute regression and must be re-authored back onto the 1958 Act.

questions.short_title: Hong Kong Convention and Indian Ship Recycling
questions.text_verbatim: Discuss the Hong Kong Convention for the Safe and Environmentally Sound Recycling of Ships. What is its significance for India, and how does India’s shipbreaking industry stand to benefit or be impacted by its implementation? (16)
reuse_evidence: VERIFIED DONOR: QP2603-Q9. Same examiner task by chronological family; its answer is built and verified in the MIW corpus.
DIRECTION: the 2024 sitting is the EARLIER one. The donor is a later answer being pulled backwards, so currency corrections made for the later sitting must be reversed, not inherited.
questions.question_delta: The printed stem is identical to the donor. The delta that matters here is not wording but DATE: QP2410-Q4 was sat at October 2024 and the donor at March 2026. Before reuse, scan the donor object for sitting-relative prose, sweep the assembled spec afterwards rather than trusting the patch list, and check whether the governing instrument itself differed at the two sittings. See temporal_review on this question.

notes: The Hong Kong Convention entered into force on 26 June 2025, eight months AFTER this sitting. At October 2024 the entry-into-force condition had been met (June 2023) but the Convention was not yet in force. An answer must say so. The November 2025 relative of this question is answered on the opposite footing, and the two must not be conflated.

(8)
